model.name: Cross-view role AGREEMENT — every consumer agrees on current-role atomically, no server-baked role copy (closes Tron's R40.56 surface reject)
model.description: Every role-consumer AGREES about a task's current-role on ONE rendered screen — by construction, atomically, ACROSS a live make-current. Tron rejected R40.56 at his surface (record aa3fa299): the pin reads '📌 Current — Task 40.1' while THAT task's drawer still offers '📌 Set as Current' — two views on one screen disagree. ROOT (verified first-hand): pinRole is BAKED into the served task payload at fetch time (attachTaskPinRole, server.ts:2901 -> rb-detail-drawer.ts:498), and the drawer NEVER subscribes to the currentsprint broadcast — so a live make-current re-derives the SUBSCRIBED tree but leaves the drawer's copy STALE. R40.56 fixed the derivation SITE (source); THIS is the LIFECYCLE gap = a second COPY with its own staleness. FIX by construction: (iii) RETIRE pinRole from the payload (a derived role is a pure fn of (thisTaskUuid, currentSlotUuid), both already live client-side — no copy = nothing to go stale = the class is ELIMINATED not mitigated); (ii) the drawer subscribes the SAME viewBusKey({type:CurrentSprint, uuid:singleton}) the tree uses (one-builder-both-sides, R37.12 Q3) and derives role AT RENDER from the ONE live current-slot -> a pin move = one event = all consumers re-derive = agreement atomic by construction.

discoverySource.tronObservation: pin reads '📌 Current — Task 40.1' while that task's drawer still offers '📌 Set as Current' — two views on one screen disagree
discoverySource.verifiedBy: robbin-req first-hand: attachTaskPinRole bakes pinRole into the /api/ior served payload (server.ts region 2901); drawer reads rModel.pinRole (rb-detail-drawer.ts:498) WITHOUT subscribing to the currentsprint broadcast = stale copy while the subscribed tree updates live

model.metaFinding: ★ SINGLE-SOURCE MEANS EVERY CONSUMER AGREES, not merely that the source is right (PO, load-bearing). R40.56's gates asserted the SOURCE (single derivation-site, resolver-correct) and PASSED; Tron's EYE asserted the AGREEMENT and FAILED it — and the eye was the stronger test. A consumer can read the correct resolver and STILL render a contradiction if its own COPY of the result is stale (a lifecycle gap, not a derivation gap). This is the 2nd time Tron's glance beat our green on this requirement. NEW GATE CLASS: consumer-vs-consumer on the RENDERED artifact (two artifacts compared to EACH OTHER), not artifact-vs-model — the class the session was missing. [[single-source-means-every-consumer-agrees]] [[assert-the-rendered-artifact-not-a-proxy]]
model.satisfactionStatus: UNVERIFIED (nothing built; ACs designed, no dynamic gate red-then-green yet — honest third state per R40.54). Dynamic-post-broadcast red-then-green is the acceptance.
model.crossRefNote: Closes what R40.56 left at the surface: R40.56 = single derivation-SITE (source, fixed); R40.57 = single live VALUE + derive-at-render (AGREEMENT, the stronger Tron-facing invariant). Both needed. viewBusKey ONE-builder-both-sides = R37.12 Q3. Rides R40.54 failable-AC family.

acceptanceCriteria.text: RETIRE pinRole from the served payload: a derived role is a pure fn of (thisTaskUuid, currentSlotUuid), both already live on the client; no copy = nothing to go stale = the disagreement class ELIMINATED, not mitigated. attachTaskPinRole retired as a payload field (server.ts:2901).

gateRef.assertion: 0 pinRole (or any baked role field) survives in the served task payload

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: seed pinRole back into the served model -> gate RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: ONE-EVENT ATOMIC AGREEMENT: the drawer subscribes the SAME viewBusKey({type:CurrentSprint,uuid:singleton}) the tree uses (ONE builder both sides, R37.12 Q3 — a raw-uuid subscribe is exactly why the tree once went stale) and derives taskRole AT RENDER by comparing its shown task's uuid to the ONE live current-slot uuid. A pin move = one event = ALL consumers re-derive = 'derived-role and pin-slot change atomically for all consumers' IS the invariant.

gateRef.assertion: drawer subscribes viewBusKey({type:CurrentSprint,uuid:singleton}) via the ONE builder; role derived at render, not read from a baked field

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: suppress the drawer subscribe -> drawer role stale after a live make-current -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: ★ CROSS-VIEW AGREEMENT (a NEW gate class: consumer-vs-consumer on the RENDERED artifact). On ONE rendered screen @390, for the SAME task, the pin/tree role and the action-bar's offered verbs MUST agree: current => Set-as-Current ABSENT; not-current => PRESENT. Asserted by SCREENSHOT, the two views checked against EACH OTHER — NOT each against the model. Every other gate we own compares an artifact to a model; THIS compares two artifacts (the gate Tron's eye is). [[assert-the-rendered-artifact-not-a-proxy]]

gateRef.assertion: on one @390 screenshot: pin/tree role and action-bar verbs agree for the same task (current<=>Set-Current-absent), views compared to each other

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: render a screen where tree shows current but drawer offers Set-as-Current -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: DYNAMIC-POST-BROADCAST IS MANDATORY (written INTO the AC so nobody later 'simplifies' it): the agreement assertion MUST be made AFTER a live make-current on a DIFFERENT task via the LIVE path (broadcast, NO drawer re-fetch), THEN screenshot. An initial-load check would PASS and MISS this bug entirely — the STATE UNDER TEST (post-broadcast, no re-fetch) IS PART OF THE ASSERTION. Initial-fetch agreement is trivial + would false-pass.

gateRef.assertion: the screenshot is taken AFTER a live make-current via broadcast (no re-fetch); agreement holds ACROSS the live event, not merely on initial load

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: assert on initial-load only -> the stub disagreement would false-PASS -> that is itself the failure (must assert post-broadcast)

acceptanceCriteria.text: ENUMERATE the role-consumers on a screen (pin badge · tree highlight · action-bar verbs · drawer · scoreboard) + a DIVERGENCE check: a NEW role-consumer must be added to the agreement set or the gate flags it (a consumer outside the cross-check can silently disagree). FAIL-CLOSED: if any enumerated consumer's role can't be read for the comparison, RED — never skip-as-pass.

gateRef.assertion: every enumerated role-consumer is in the agreement cross-check; a new/unreadable consumer => RED (not skip)

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: add a new role-consumer NOT in the agreement set -> divergence RED; make a consumer's role unreadable -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: STUB-MUST-FAIL: inject a disagreement — re-bake a stale pinRole into the payload OR suppress the drawer's broadcast subscription -> a screen where the tree shows current but the drawer offers Set-as-Current -> the gate MUST RED. A gate that can't be made to fail by injecting a disagreement is not asserting agreement. This IS the R40.56-defect specimen at the RENDER layer (the strongest baseline).

gateRef.assertion: injected disagreement (stale pinRole re-baked / drawer-subscribe suppressed) => gate RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: PENDING: the injected-disagreement stub is the acceptance proof the gate asserts AGREEMENT, not source

model.reconciliationNote: 2026-08-24 (additive, scope UNCHANGED — architect: R40.57 STANDS as-is): the uuid-form hypothesis was MEASURED + KILLED; the LIVE current-role bug is D1 = a field-read (.uuid vs .taskUuid, false as-cast server.ts:1402) minted as sibling R40.58 44864641. R40.57 = D3 (lifecycle/AGREEMENT) is MASKED today (pinRole always 'other' via D1) and becomes the visible bug once D1 lands. R40.57's derive-at-render comparison must use D2's canonical bareUuid (R40.58) so the client does not re-introduce a form gap. ONE build/deploy order D1->D3->D2.
